no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not refer this NDA to an advisory committee because the application did not raise significant public health questions regarding the role of lurbinectedin for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA 213702 (ZEPZELCA/lurbinectedin). The FDA Multidiscipline Review states the Division did not refer the NDA to an advisory committee because the application did not raise significant public health questions and the benefit-risk profile was favorable. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
